title: WORKSHEET 8
subject: Simple Past and Past Continuous
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 8: Simple Past and Past Continuous

sections.instruction: Fill in the blanks with a correct form of PAST CONTINUOUS.

acceptedAnswers: was skating

sections.instruction: How did it happen? (Example: How did Alice hurt herself? (play soccer) → She hurt herself while she was playing soccer.)

questions.prompt: How did Martin burn himself? (iron his clothes)
acceptedAnswers: He burned himself while he was ironing his clothes.
He burnt himself while he was ironing his clothes.
Martin burned himself while he was ironing his clothes.
questions.explanation: interrupted action: past continuous + past simple

sections.instruction: What's the matter? Make dialogues as in the example, using the table. Write the last line of each dialogue: what happened while the person was doing the activity. (Example: You: Hi, Tina! What's the matter with your foot? Tina: I broke it. You: How did it happen? Tina: I fell on the ice while I was ice-skating.)

questions.prompt: You: Hi, Jack! What's the matter with your leg? Jack: I broke it. You: How did it happen? Jack: (kick the goalpost / play football)
acceptedAnswers: I kicked the goalpost while I was playing football.
While I was playing football, I kicked the goalpost.
questions.explanation: interrupted action: past continuous + past simple

questions.prompt: You: Hi, Bob! What's the matter with your hand? Bob: I injured it. You: How did it happen? Bob: (fall off the bike / cycle)
acceptedAnswers: I fell off the bike while I was cycling.
I fell off my bike while I was cycling.
While I was cycling, I fell off the bike.
questions.explanation: fall → fell; interrupted action: past continuous + past simple

questions.prompt: You: Hi, Ann! What's the matter with your arm? Ann: I broke it. You: How did it happen? Ann: (fall over / skate)
acceptedAnswers: I fell over while I was skating.
While I was skating, I fell over.
questions.explanation: fall → fell; interrupted action: past continuous + past simple

questions.prompt: You: Hi, Alice! What's the matter with your ankle? Alice: I sprained it. You: How did it happen? Alice: (trip over the carpet / dance)
acceptedAnswers: I tripped over the carpet while I was dancing.
While I was dancing, I tripped over the carpet.
questions.explanation: trip → tripped; interrupted action: past continuous + past simple

questions.prompt: Yesterday Tom and Janice [gap] (go) to the zoo around one. They [gap] (see) many kinds of animals. They stayed at the zoo for two hours. While they [gap] (walk) home, it [gap] (begin) to rain, so they [gap] (stop) at a small café and [gap] (have) a cup of coffee.

questions.prompt: Yesterday afternoon I [gap] (go) to visit the Parker family. When I [gap] (get) there around two o'clock, Mrs. Parker [gap] (be) in the yard. She [gap] (plant) flowers in her garden. Mr. Parker [gap] (be) in the garage. He [gap] (work) on their car. He [gap] (change) the oil.

sections.instruction: What's the question? Use the question words in the box. (Example: Who did you visit? → I visited my cousin.)

questions.prompt: Answer: We talked about my job.
acceptedAnswers: What did you talk about?

questions.prompt: Answer: She went to the beach.
acceptedAnswers: Where did she go?

questions.prompt: Answer: She met her friend.
acceptedAnswers: Who did she meet?

questions.prompt: Answer: They spoke Russian.
acceptedAnswers: What language did they speak?
What did they speak?
What kind of language did they speak?

questions.prompt: Answer: They swam in the ocean.
acceptedAnswers: Where did they swim?

questions.prompt: Answer: He had dinner at 8:00.
acceptedAnswers: When did he have dinner?
What time did he have dinner?

questions.prompt: Answer: I baked an apple pie.
acceptedAnswers: What kind of pie did you bake?
What did you bake?

questions.prompt: Answer: She cried because her dog ran away.
acceptedAnswers: Why did she cry?

questions.prompt: Answer: I stayed for a week.
acceptedAnswers: How long did you stay?

questions.prompt: Answer: I came home by train.
acceptedAnswers: How did you come home?
How did you get home?

questions.prompt: Answer: He ate three hamburgers.
acceptedAnswers: How many hamburgers did he eat?

questions.prompt: Answer: He left the restaurant at 9:00.
acceptedAnswers: When did he leave the restaurant?
What time did he leave the restaurant?

questions.prompt: Answer: She wrote a letter to her mother.

Who did she write to?
What did she write to her mother?

questions.prompt: Answer: They studied all morning.

When did they study?

questions.prompt: Answer: We took a lot of photographs.

What did you take?

What did you send to your teacher?

questions.prompt: Answer: I lost my wallet while I was skating.

What did you lose?
